svg.text: One square per exported entry point. Color = status.

g.title: NGX / DLSS -> FSR/XeSS - 945 entry points - Translated shim - NGX calls forwarded to AMD FSR/XeSS; not NVIDIA DLSS
CUDA Driver API (ZLUDA) - 731 entry points - Verified - Full driver surface: devices, contexts, memory, streams, modules, launches
cuBLAS - 530 entry points - ZLUDA-backed - Bundled ZLUDA cuBLAS 11/12/13
cuSPARSE - 448 entry points - ZLUDA-backed - Bundled ZLUDA cuSPARSE 10/11/12
NVML (Ghost stub) - 342 entry points - ABI stub - Identity and VRAM queries; not full NVML
nvcuvid / nvldumd (not covered) - 342 entry points - Not covered - ABI stubs only; no video decode/encode path
TensorRT (not bundled, estimated) - 300 entry points - Not covered - No TensorRT module in the Ghost stack; estimate for scale
cuDNN 8/9 - 221 entry points - ZLUDA-backed - Bundled ZLUDA cuDNN 8 and 9
cuSOLVER (not bundled, estimated) - 200 entry points - Not covered - No cuSOLVER module in the Ghost stack; estimate for scale
CUPTI (ABI stub, not covered) - 189 entry points - Not covered - ABI stubs only; no functional profiling path
NCCL (not bundled, estimated) - 100 entry points - Not covered - No NCCL module in the Ghost stack; estimate for scale
cuRAND (not bundled, estimated) - 80 entry points - Not covered - No cuRAND module in the Ghost stack; estimate for scale
cuFFT - 60 entry points - ZLUDA-backed - Bundled ZLUDA cuFFT 10/11/12
OptiX (ABI 41/87) - 48 entry points - In progress - 48 ABI 87 entries; hardware ray-query backend in active development
cuBLASLt - 45 entry points - ZLUDA-backed - Bundled ZLUDA cuBLASLt 11/12/13
nvJPEG (not bundled, estimated) - 40 entry points - Not covered - No nvJPEG module in the Ghost stack; estimate for scale
Aftermath (ABI stub, not covered) - 23 entry points - Not covered - ABI stubs only; no functional crash-analysis path
NVRTC - 21 entry points - Verified - NVRTC tee plus real NVRTC; runtime kernel compilation
CUDA-Vulkan interop - 9 entry points - Verified - External memory and semaphore bridge
Vulkan layer - 8 entry points - Verified - Ghost Vulkan compatibility layer

svg.text: Red = not covered: Video, CUPTI, Aftermath, TensorRT, NCCL, cuRAND, cuSOLVER, nvJPEG.
ABI stubs keep the interface only. Absent-module surfaces are estimated.
